description_target.target_text: Two anchor blocks plus local top/side keys generate the repeated rectangular frame

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Two solid same-size anchor squares (top-left A, bottom-right B) fix
 ;; the corners of a rectangular truss; nearby sample cells define its
 ;; palette. Rebuild the whole truss on a blank canvas: solid top and
 ;; bottom chords one row outside the anchor rows, dash-4 patterned
 ;; rows through the anchor bands, all four corner anchors, and side
 ;; rails between the bands cycling solid rung / rail+inner rung / bare
 ;; rails on a 4-row phase.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode g -1))
     (define objs (objects g bg))
     (define (solid? o) (= (obj-size o) (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o))))
     (define anchor-color  ;; a color with two same-size solid rects
       (find-first
        (lambda (color)
          (let ((same (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) color)
                                               (solid? o)))
                              objs)))
            (any? (lambda (a)
                    (any? (lambda (b)
                            (and (not (equal? (obj-bbox a) (obj-bbox b)))
                                 (= (obj-h a) (obj-h b))
                                 (= (obj-w a) (obj-w b))))
                          same))
                  same)))
        (grid-colors g bg)))
     (define anchors
       (sort-by (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) anchor-color)
                                         (solid? o)))
                        objs)
                (lambda (o) (+ (* 1000 (obj-r1 o)) (obj-c1 o)))))
     (define a (first anchors))
     (define b (last anchors))
     (define ar1 (obj-r1 a)) (define ac1 (obj-c1 a))
     (define ar2 (obj-r2 a)) (define ac2 (obj-c2 a))
     (define br1 (obj-r1 b)) (define bc1 (obj-c1 b))
     (define br2 (obj-r2 b)) (define bc2 (obj-c2 b))
     (define top-color (at g ar1 (+ ac2 1)))
     (define horiz-color  ;; second color along A's top row
       (for/first ((c (range (+ ac2 2) w))
                   #:when (let ((v (at g ar1 c)))
                            (and (not (= v bg))
                                 (not (= v anchor-color))
                                 (not (= v top-color)))))
         (at g ar1 c)))
     (define side-color  ;; first color below A
       (for*/first ((r (range (+ ar2 1) h)) (c (range ac1 (+ ac2 1)))
                    #:when (let ((v (at g r c)))
                             (and (not (= v bg))
                                  (not (= v anchor-color)))))
         (at g r c)))
     (define side-inner  ;; second color below A
       (for*/first ((r (range (+ ar2 1) h)) (c (range ac1 (+ ac2 1)))
                    #:when (let ((v (at g r c)))
                             (and (not (= v bg))
                                  (not (= v anchor-color))
                                  (not (= v side-color)))))
         (at g r c)))
     (define (paint-rect out r1 c1 r2 c2 color)
       (for*/fold ((acc out)) ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1)))
                               (c (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
         (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell acc r c color) acc)))
     (define gap-c1 (+ ac2 1))
     (define gap-c2 (- bc1 1))
     (define chords  ;; solid lines just outside the anchor rows
       (paint-rect (paint-rect (empty-grid h w bg)
                               (- ar1 1) gap-c1 (- ar1 1) gap-c2 top-color)
                   (+ br2 1) gap-c1 (+ br2 1) gap-c2 top-color))
     (define banded  ;; dash-4 pattern through both anchor bands
       (foldl (lambda (r acc)
                (for/fold ((out acc)) ((c (range gap-c1 (+ gap-c2 1))))
                  (set-cell out r c
                            (let ((phase (modulo (- c gap-c1) 4)))
                              (cond ((zero? phase) top-color)
                                    ((= phase 2) horiz-color)
                                    (else bg))))))
              chords
              (append (range ar1 (+ ar2 1)) (range br1 (+ br2 1)))))
     (define cornered
       (paint-rect (paint-rect (paint-rect (paint-rect banded
                                                       ar1 ac1 ar2 ac2
                                                       anchor-color)
                                           ar1 bc1 ar2 bc2 anchor-color)
                               br1 ac1 br2 ac2 anchor-color)
                   br1 bc1 br2 bc2 anchor-color))
     (foldl (lambda (r acc)  ;; side rails between the bands, phase 4
              (let ((phase (modulo (- r (+ ar2 1)) 4)))
                (cond ((zero? phase)  ;; full rungs
                       (paint-rect (paint-rect acc
                                               r (- ac1 1) r ac2
                                               side-color)
                                   r bc1 r (+ bc2 1) side-color))
                      ((= phase 2)  ;; rails + inner rungs
                       (paint-rect
                        (paint-rect
                         (paint-rect
                          (paint-rect acc r (- ac1 1) r (- ac1 1)
                                      side-color)
                          r ac1 r ac2 side-inner)
                         r bc1 r bc2 side-inner)
                        r (+ bc2 1) r (+ bc2 1) side-color))
                      (else  ;; bare rails
                       (paint-rect (paint-rect acc
                                               r (- ac1 1) r (- ac1 1)
                                               side-color)
                                   r (+ bc2 1) r (+ bc2 1) side-color)))))
            cornered
            (range (+ ar2 1) br1)))))
